name: ebay/product
description: Get an eBay product by product ID: title, price, condition, quantity sold, item specifics, media, shipping, returns and seller details.

lang.description: The language to use for the search. Normally, it defaults to `en-US`, but some locales use localized interface (Japan, Argentina etc.) so override might be helpful. This parameter available only for `United States` eBay domain and only when `locale` is set.

locale.description: From where you want the search to originate from. Head to the eBay locales for a full list of supported locales.

product_id.description: An ID of the product to get results for. Normally, it can be found in product link from search results: `https://www.ebay.com/itm/{product_id}`

ebay_domain.description: The eBay domain to use. It defaults to `ebay.com`. Head to the eBay domains for a full list of supported domains.

json_restrictor.description: The fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

shipping_country.description: The shipping country to use for shipping data calculation. Head to the eBay shipping countries for a full list of supported countries.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.
